purpose: Adapters for strict nineteenth-century slide cabinets, university teaching collections, Haeckel/Castracane microfossil collections and a bounded Farlow exsiccata set.
guards: Keep historical production dates, inferred collection-formation phases and later donations or museum accessions separate.
Do not turn species counts, accession suffixes or digital-image totals into physical slide counts.
Keep replicated teaching or exsiccata sets at copy level; serial numbers shared between institutions do not imply one physical object.
Separate original nineteenth-century slides from modern topotype or isotype slides newly prepared from surviving source samples.

adapters.institution_scope: University of Manchester Museum of Medicine and Health Gibson microscope slide collection
adapters.target: peer-reviewed 2025 collection study plus referenced MMH tray and slide records
adapters.promotion_rule: Recover MMH tray/position records and dated slide labels, isolate pre-1900 objects, and preserve the undocumented original ownership plus probable Southport collecting context as an inference rather than a fact.

adapters.institution_scope: University of St Andrews Bell-Pettigrew Zoology microscope slide collection
adapters.target: official BPM/1 and BP:C79 collection hierarchy with maker/contributor subgroups
adapters.promotion_rule: Traverse subgroup and item hierarchy for creators, makers, dates and labels; isolate nineteenth-century records without projecting the whole long-lived university teaching collection backwards.

adapters.institution_scope: Ernst-Haeckel-Haus Jena Messina radiolarian research slides
adapters.target: Joint Haeckel and Ehrenberg Project monograph and bounded two-box Messina 1859 study corpus
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve the two research boxes, species/publication links and any recoverable slide identifiers; keep them distinct from distributed Haeckel teaching-slide sets.

adapters.institution_scope: Natural History Museum London Haeckel radiolarian slide collection
adapters.target: Joint Haeckel and Ehrenberg Project slide list, locality table and digital captures
adapters.promotion_rule: Model 238 teaching-slide objects as seven replicated 34-slide sets while keeping the additional plankton-slide corpus separately counted; capture station/locality and preservation information from project tables.

adapters.institution_scope: Natural History Museum London Castracane HMS Challenger diatom collection
adapters.target: illustrated type catalogue and Joint Haeckel and Ehrenberg Project collection description
adapters.promotion_rule: Enumerate the bounded 143-slide historical corpus with type annotations and locality labels; keep 27 modern slides newly prepared from original Challenger subsamples outside the nineteenth-century count.

adapters.institution_scope: Harvard Farlow Herbarium Kitton Norfolk Diatoms
adapters.target: official annotated catalogue for Kitton numbers 1-100 and manuscript-catalogue cross-reference
adapters.promotion_rule: Harvest all 100 set positions with taxa/localities and manuscript links while treating Farlow as one physical institutional copy of a replicated set also held at BM.
